Done. The plan at `out/T3/plan.yaml` ran successfully on the first and only execution.

What the plan does, in order:
- Asserts the input has 244 tensors.
- Deletes the 48 buffers with a regex on `attention.(bias|masked_bias|rotary_emb.inv_freq)`, then asserts 196 remain.
- Upcasts every tensor in place to float32.
- Asserts the projection regex matches exactly 64 tensors, then casts those in place to bfloat16.
- Final `all` assert covers the required checks: 64 projections are bfloat16, the regex complement is float32 (so no stray bfloat16 tensor can slip through), layer 0 query_key_value is bfloat16, embed_in is float32, and the total is 196.
- Output is written to `out/T3` with a 256MB shard budget.

Output verification from the index file:

| Item | Result |
|---|---|
| Tensors in weight_map | 196 |
| Shards | 9 |
| embed_in / embed_out | alone in shards 1 and 2 |
| Buffers remaining | 0 |
| Largest packed shard | under 256 MiB |

The self-report is at `out/T3/REPORT.md`, noting one execution, no failures, and the two things I had to work out: expressing "exactly 64 bfloat16" via a complement pattern, and deleting buffers before the blanket float32 upcast.
